changelog: New (Pro): Invisibility Cloak. Turn it on in Settings → Widgets, then press Ctrl+Alt+H to blur your screen instantly.
Midnight Liquid theme now matches the website's molten-liquid look.
Fullscreen music: tap the cover to see which app is playing, 5 visualizers, and smoother synced lyrics.
Compact dashboard with no scrolling; the side notch fits completely.
Notchy colours per agent: Claude orange, Gemini blue, Codex green.
Bar and Pill: layouts adapt to size, auto-hide is more reliable and notifications no longer block clicks.
Stability: fewer crashes, a frozen notch recovers automatically and memory use is lower.
